description: This file defines the CustomerGroup controller class within the Opencart admin system, handling CRUD operations for customer groups, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting customer groups, along with associated views and permissions.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer groups in the admin panel, providing methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting customer groups.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the customer group list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of customer groups, typically called via AJAX or internal routing.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of customer groups, including pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a customer group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving customer group data from the form, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customer groups after permission validation.
